status: pre-build source-level ground truth; freeze a descriptor-verified copy after APK compilation
safety: Every payload method calls a real Android API (unlike SyntheticMalApp, which is deliberately inert). Deliberately excludes SEND_SMS/READ_SMS/RECEIVE_SMS/BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE/INTERNET (same forbidden set as SyntheticMalApp/verify_manifest.py) - it can read on-device location/contacts/call-log/telephony-ID data and write its own private storage, but cannot message anyone, exfiltrate over a network, or hijack the UI via an accessibility service.
unit_of_evaluation: Java source method until APK descriptors are verified

methods.why: Real LocationManager.getLastKnownLocation() call - genuine GPS location access, matches MalLoc behavior-1's 'Collecting Location Data' cue exactly.
Real ContentResolver.query(ContactsContract.Contacts.CONTENT_URI) - genuine contact-list read, matches MalLoc behavior-1's 'Accessing Contact Lists' cue exactly.

Real TelephonyManager.getLine1Number() call - genuine telephony API usage (MalLoc behavior-2's own 'Look for' cue), safely reinterpreted away from actual SMS send/intercept/delete - no SEND_SMS/READ_SMS/RECEIVE_SMS permission exists anywhere in this app.
Real ContentResolver.query(CallLog.Calls.CONTENT_URI) - matches MalLoc behavior-2's 'Monitoring call logs' cue exactly.
Real java.io.File.exists() root-binary probe (/system/xbin/su, /system/bin/su) - matches MalLoc behavior-7's 'Root checking' cue exactly, using only a permission-free stdlib API.

Real Context.openFileOutput()/FileOutputStream write - matches MalLoc behavior-7's 'System file modifications' cue, sandboxed to this app's own private storage only (cannot touch a real system path or another app's data).

Real PackageManager.setComponentEnabledSetting() disabling this app's own launcher activity - matches MalLoc behavior-11's 'Icon/label manipulation' and 'App hiding mechanisms' cues exactly; targets only this app's own component (no system permission needed or held).

Real Settings.Secure.getString(ANDROID_ID) read - a genuine device-identifier fingerprinting primitive commonly paired with evasion/tricky-behavior logic in real malware; needs no dangerous permission.
Launcher Activity entry point; wires ScenarioRouter. Excluded from payload precision/recall per METHODOLOGY.md.

Wires 4 of the 8 payload methods (Privacy + Escalation scenarios) via Runnable dispatch - the same lambda/anonymous-class dispatch pattern used to stress-test AGLL's callback-dispatch-edge heuristic in SyntheticMalApp. Excluded from payload precision/recall.

Exported BroadcastReceiver entry point (reachable without user interaction, unlike MainActivity) - wires the 2 TelephonyScenario payloads directly and starts MaintenanceService. Tests entry-point detection against a component type SyntheticMalApp never exercised. Excluded from payload precision/recall.

Non-exported Service entry point, reached only via SyncReceiver's internal startService() call - wires the 2 TrickyScenario payloads. Tests entry-point detection against a Service reached transitively through another component, not directly from the manifest. Excluded from payload precision/recall.
